items.headline: Makhachev makes history — 17 straight wins, a new UFC record
items.body: A bloodied Islam Makhachev outlasted Ian Machado Garry by unanimous decision in Philadelphia to keep his welterweight belt and push his win streak to 17 — passing Anderson Silva's legendary mark for the longest in UFC history.
items.say: Did you catch Makhachev? He just broke the UFC's all-time win-streak record.

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler runs away with it — an 8-shot win at the St. Jude
items.body: Scheffler closed out the FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight, the biggest winning margin in the event's 68-year history, ending a nearly seven-month drought and grabbing the No. 1 seed heading into the FedExCup Playoffs.
items.say: Scheffler won by eight this weekend — is anyone else even close right now?

items.headline: Sabalenka survives a scare — six match points to get past Gibson
items.body: World No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka rifled 13 aces on a hot, gusty day in Cincinnati but needed six match points to shake off qualifier Talia Gibson, 6-2, 7-6(2), in a bumpy US Open tune-up.
items.say: Sabalenka needed six match points to close one out — brutal in that wind.

items.headline: Big swings in Houston — Raleigh and Arozarena down the Astros
items.body: Cal Raleigh snapped a homer drought and Randy Arozarena went deep in the first inning as the Mariners edged the AL West-leading Astros 3-2 in a Sunday night thriller.
items.say: Cal Raleigh's back to mashing — Seattle just stole one from the Astros in Houston.

items.headline: The field's set for Dota's biggest stage — TI playoffs begin Thursday
items.body: The International's group stage wrapped in Shanghai with eight teams left standing — Team Vision on top, defending champs Team Falcons still alive, and Cinderella squad Iron Wing crashing the party — with the Aegis on the line starting Aug 20.
items.say: The International playoffs start Thursday — eight teams left and millions on the line.

items.headline: The Gang's back tonight — 'It's Always Sunny' returns for Season 18
items.body: TV's longest-running live-action sitcom kicks off a full 10-episode season on FXX tonight, complete with a Renaissance faire, a wedding, and every degenerate you remember from Paddy's Pub.
items.say: New 'Always Sunny' starts tonight — a Ren faire AND a wedding, apparently.

items.headline: The Pogues ride off for good — 'Outer Banks' drops its final season Thursday
items.body: Netflix's treasure-hunt hit returns for its fifth and final chapter on Aug 20 — all 10 episodes at once — with the crew out for revenge after last season's gut-punch.
items.say: Outer Banks' last season lands Thursday — perfect binge for the weekend.

items.headline: Spooky season starts early — 'Insidious: Out of the Further' opens Friday
items.body: The sixth Insidious film creeps into theaters Aug 21, following a young mom who discovers she can cross into The Further — Lin Shaye's haunted realm of lost souls.
items.say: New Insidious hits theaters Friday if you're up for a good scare.

items.headline: Trippie Redd drops a 25-track monster — 'NDA' is here
items.body: Trippie Redd's sixth album landed stacked with features — Lil Wayne, Young Thug, Sexyy Red — led by the eerie, Backrooms-inspired video for 'SWAGGER.'
items.say: You hear the new Trippie Redd album? Twenty-five tracks — the 'SWAGGER' video is wild.
